OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnS.en: On sunny days, I step out and gaze\nupon the volcano.\pThat's my daily routine.
OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnS.fr: Les jours de soleil, je sors et je\ncontemple le volcan.\pC'est ma routine quotidienne.

OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberEru.en: Let me think… When was the last\ntime MT. EMBER erupted?
OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberEru.fr: Voyons… Quand le MONT BRAISE est-il\nentré en éruption pour la dernière\lfois ?
